title: SessionMessageParams
description: Send a message to a worker's agent (or one of its own workers), or cancel one still queued. Exactly one of the two disjoint forms: the send form (text, when, id, and — when when is "now" — tokenId) or the cancel form (cancel).

sessionId.description: The worker whose pane to message, exactly as session.read read it.

text.description: The message text, delivered as a paste followed by Enter. Send-form only.

when.description: "free": queue and deliver once the agent is free — returns queued immediately. "now": attempt delivery within this call, under tokenId's target (kind input or working). Send-form only, and required with text.

id.description: This message's idempotency key: a resend with the SAME text/when (and, for "now", the same target kind) returns the recorded phase rather than sending a second time; a resend with a different payload is refused. Send-form only, and required with text.

tokenId.description: A prior session.read target's tokenId, of kind input or working. Required when when is "now"; ignored (the delivery mints its own fresh targets) once queued for "free" delivery.

cancel.description: The cancel form: withdraw the still-queued message with this id. Disjoint from text/when/id/tokenId — a call never carries both forms.

result.title: SessionMessageResult
result.description: The send form's result (a MessageView) or the cancel form's result — disjoint, exactly as the params are. Inlined rather than $ref'd to sibling $defs entries: contract tests compile $defs/result standalone (extracted from this file), so a $ref reaching outside it would not resolve.

namespace.description: "caller" for every session.message a model sent; "nocx" is reserved for the owed task and never appears on a send-form response to a caller's own call.

phase.description: The closed phase set. In flight: queued, pasting, awaiting_echo, entering, awaiting_submission. Terminal: refused (nothing written), failed_partial/delivery_unknown (paste incomplete, see bytesWritten), partial (paste written, echo not confirmed, Enter not sent — see boxContents), written (Enter written, submission not confirmed), submitted, cancelled, indeterminate (a step's own outcome could not be learned).

bytesWritten.description: Present chiefly for failed_partial and delivery_unknown: bytes of the paste actually written.

boxContents.description: Present for partial: what the input box holds right now, so a caller can see what it would be adding to.

result.description: cancelled: the message was queued and is now cancelled, or was already cancelled (idempotent). too_late: the paste step was already claimed and may be written; see phase. no_such_message: no record for that id — the one result exempt from the phase rule.

phase.description: Present exactly when result is not no_such_message.
